# [In preview] Public Preview: Major version upgrades (MVU) for Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters

## What Changed

MVUs are now available for elastic clusters in Azure Database for PostgreSQL. You can upgrade an existing elastic cluster to a supported newer PostgreSQL version in place without provisioning a replacement cluster, migrating distributed data, or changing
